2012. Employee Salary Using Abstract Class

60

Medium

Problem Statement

Create an abstract class Employee with:

name
An abstract method calculateSalary()

Create two subclasses:

FullTimeEmployee — has a monthly salary.
PartTimeEmployee — has hourly rate and number of hours.

Override calculateSalary() in both classes and print the calculated salary.
input_spec:
The first line contains the employee type: fulltime or parttime.

For fulltime, the second line contains the monthly salary.

For parttime, the second line contains the hourly rate and number of hours.
